annot.p: S solo and coro (4+1), A solo and coro (4), T solo and coro (4), B solo and coro (4), S coro (3), A coro (3), T coro (3), B coro (3), cnto 1 (3), cnto 2 (3), clno 1 (2), clno 2 (2), trb 1 (3+1), trb 2 (3+1), trb 3 (3+1), timp (1), vl 1 (4), vl 2 (4), vla 1 (3), vla 2 (3), vlne (8), org (8), mdc (7); clno* 1 (2), clno* 2 (2), trb+vla 1 (4), trb+vla 2 (4)

Title page and available parts indicate that the work can be performed with alternative instruments: (1) The part for vla 1 and trb 1 can either be played continuously by one in­strument, or divided between the two; the same applies to the pair vla/trb 2 (parts denoted “trb+vla” above). (2) High wind instruments either comprise two cnto and two clno or only two clno, which then also play some sections of the cnto (parts denoted “clno*” above).
